title: Merge a local feature branch
task: Bring the feature branch into main. Stay on main and keep feature.txt with the feature content.
hints: Inspect git branch and git log --oneline --all.
Run git merge feature, then git status.

checks.label: The committed file contains the feature

checks.label: The feature commit is reachable from the active branch
checks.feedback: Merge the actual feature branch so Git retains its history.
